name: systemap
description: The systemap skill makes a system map from source facts and examined claims. Reader text obeys the configured writing profile: plain or ASD-STE100.

command.title: systemap command
command.description: The command that starts systemap, for example "systemap" or "uvx systemap". The plugin adds "live --port 0 --json --no-watch" to this command. Do not use "uv run systemap". That command builds the project of the repository, and the build can run code of the repository.

autostart.title: Start the live map with each session
autostart.description: If true, the live map starts when a session starts in a systemap repository. The live map reads map/model.py without running its code, unless SYSTEMAP_TRUST_MODEL_CODE=1 is in the environment of Claude Code. If the command option runs code of the repository, the code of the repository can run when the live map starts.
